# Polynomial and variety catalog

<!-- GENERATED by generate-readme.sh. Edit catalog files or the generator, not catalog rows here. -->

Exhaustive target: every explicit polynomial and every explicit variety/scheme/ideal/system in *Computations in Algebraic Geometry with Macaulay 2*.

Each polynomial has exactly three siblings: one primary render slot, provenance, and why-it-is-mentioned.

A polynomial is not the same object as a variety; composite varieties appear separately below.
